'''Darth Andru's son''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who was a son and apprentice of [[Darth Andru]], just like his [[Darth Andru's daughter|sister]]. The siblings eventually conspired against their master and [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Andru's son is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
